name: powergrader-automation
description: PowerGrader E2E Automation Framework for LMS Integration Testing

scripts.old:patch-report: shx mv allure-report/index.html allure-report/report.html && shx cp index.html allure-report/index.html && shx cp testrail-stats.json allure-report/testrail-stats.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const LIMIT=24*1024*1024;const root='allure-report/data/attachments';if(!fs.existsSync(root)){console.log('No attachments dir:',root);process.exit(0);}for(const f of fs.readdirSync(root)){const p=path.join(root,f);if(!fs.statSync(p).isFile()) continue;const s=fs.statSync(p).size;if(s>LIMIT){console.log('Deleting oversized attachment:',p,'size',Math.round(s/1024/1024*10)/10,'MiB');fs.rmSync(p,{force:true});}}"
scripts.patch-report: node calculate-reliability.js && shx mv allure-report/index.html allure-report/report.html && shx cp index.html allure-report/index.html && shx cp testrail-stats.json allure-report/testrail-stats.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const LIMIT=24*1024*1024;const root='allure-report/data/attachments';if(!fs.existsSync(root)){process.exit(0);}for(const f of fs.readdirSync(root)){const p=path.join(root,f);if(!fs.statSync(p).isFile()) continue;if(fs.statSync(p).size>LIMIT){fs.rmSync(p,{force:true});}}"
scripts.deploy-hub: npm run sync && npm run generate-report && npm run patch-report && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first npx wrangler pages deploy ./allure-report --project-name=powergrader-automation-qa-hub --skip-caching --commit-dirty=true

strip-large-allure: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const LIMIT=24*1024*1024;function walk(d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else{const s=fs.statSync(p).size;if(s>LIMIT){console.log('Deleting',p,'size',Math.round(s/1024/1024*10)/10,'MiB');fs.rmSync(p,{force:true});}}}} if(fs.existsSync('allure-report')) walk('allure-report');"
